name: KOReader
insteadOf: Amazon Kindle / Kobo / Google Play Books / Apple Books
hook: An open-source, distraction-free document and ebook reader engine for E-Ink devices, Android, Linux, and macOS.
bullets: Universal document support: EPUB, PDF, MOBI, CBZ, CBR, FB2, TXT, and DjVu
Advanced typography controls, font kerning, custom margins, and continuous or paginated reading modes
Multi-device progress sync via open-source sync servers, plus Calibre and OPDS library integration
Built-in dictionary lookups, Wikipedia integration, text-to-speech, and full-text search
benefits: Break free from proprietary DRM bookstores and Kindle/Kobo ecosystem walls
Supercharge e-ink devices like Kindle and Kobo with jailbreak-friendly, lightning-fast rendering
Read complex technical PDFs comfortably with advanced margin cropping and text reflow
Zero telemetry, zero ads, and zero account requirements to read your own books
setupSteps: Install KOReader on your Android phone, tablet, desktop, or jailbroken Kindle/Kobo e-reader
Transfer your ebooks via USB, Calibre Content Server, or built-in OPDS catalog
Customize reading gestures, typography, contrast, and font settings
Optionally configure KOReader sync server to keep reading progress synchronized across devices
details: KOReader is a versatile, distraction-free document and ebook reader built specifically for e-ink readers and mobile devices. Developed in Lua and C, KOReader delivers unmatched speed, battery efficiency, and typography control across platforms including Android, Linux, macOS, and jailbroken Kindle, Kobo, PocketBook, and Tolino devices. It natively renders almost every major digital reading format—including EPUB, PDF, CBZ/CBR comic archives, MOBI, FB2, and DjVu. For PDFs, KOReader includes intelligent K2pdfopt-powered text reflow and automatic margin cropping, making multi-column academic papers legible even on small screens. With OPDS catalog browsing, Calibre sync, offline StarDict dictionary lookup, and custom reading stats, KOReader is the ultimate open-source reading companion. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.
